purpose: Production candidate for visible P2P energy sharing: SoftPeakSlackMILP upper planner emits a non-zero inter-station share plan, DefaultLowerAgent is overlaid with C6 forecast-aware safety shield. This is the share-aware successor to v3 fallback_shield, not a learned shared SAC policy.

data.evaluation_note: Endpoint-level smoke/e2e must check total_share_abs_kwh > 0 plus peak/soc validity. Learned Shared PI-SAC remains a research follow-up.

upper_model.description: SoftPeakSlackMILPPlanner: lexicographic plan that first minimizes peak-limit slack, then grid+transfer cost. Reads regional station_config/share_abs_max from day_data when present.

lower_models.description: DefaultLowerAgent: zero action, then overridden by C6 forecast-aware safety shield.

deployment_notes.scenario_override: regional_virtual_hub injects a 3-hub physical spec through day_data, so planner and shield use peak_limit=850, ESS=16000kWh per hub, and share_abs_max=250 for aggregate Jeju demand.
deployment_notes.research_boundary: This candidate demonstrates share-aware dispatch in production responses. It is not the final SAC-standard shared policy; Shared PI-SAC must still be trained/evaluated separately.

api_output_schema_additions.dispatch.commands[].share_energy_kwh: positive means station receives energy; negative means station exports energy
